Reason: In Figure 1a, dense bilateral consolidations are present, especially in the lower zones; in Figure 1b, these opacities are less dense and reduced in extent (partial resolution), but fine reticular markings—particularly in the peripheral and basal regions—are more conspicuous than in 1a, consistent with evolving interstitial changes.
